name: University ontology
description: A larger example ontology about a university: people, organisation, teaching and research.

props.name: member of
props.description: Belongs to an organisation in any capacity.

props.name: employed by
props.description: Has a contract of employment with.

props.name: enrolled in
props.description: Is registered as a student of a programme.

props.name: takes
props.description: Attends an edition of a course.

props.name: teaches
props.description: Gives an edition of a course.

props.name: edition of
props.description: The course this edition is a run of.

props.name: part of
props.description: Is a component of a larger whole.

props.name: supervises
props.description: Guides the research or thesis work of.

props.name: participates in
props.description: Takes part in a research project.

props.name: awards
props.description: The degree a programme leads to.

props.name: has field
props.description: The research field something is about.

terms.name: Person
terms.description: A human being with a role at or around the university.

terms.name: PhD candidate
terms.description: A doctoral researcher, who is both a student and a member of academic staff.

terms.name: Course edition
terms.description: One run of a course in a particular academic period.

terms.name: Full name
terms.description: The name a person is formally known by.

terms.name: Start date
terms.description: When an appointment or project begins.

terms.name: Capacity
terms.description: Maximum number of participants or seats.
